FN-EZD52C-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 306
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Paul W. Lee
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/18/2023
House Bill 306 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Board of
Dental Examiners of Alabama to adopt rules that would regulate the provision of teledentistry
by dentists, as provided by this bill.
Page 1
